title: Evolution: Natural Selection — Nature’s Engine of Evolution
author: BiosystemsHub Editorial Team
description: Explore how natural selection shapes adaptations, drives evolution, and explains examples from beetle camouflage to antibiotic resistance.

title: Protein Synthesis — DNA to Functional Protein
author: BiosystemsHub Editorial Team
description: Learn how cells build proteins from genetic instructions through transcription, translation, and post-translational processing.

title: Ecology: How Ocean Prey Evade Predators
author: BiosystemsHub Editorial Team
description: Discover how ocean prey use camouflage, hiding, speed, and warning signals to avoid predators and survive in the sea.

title: Marine Biology: Ocean Zones And Why Coral Reefs Matter
author: BiosystemsHub Editorial Team
description: An introduction to ocean zones, the importance of coral reefs, and how plastic pollution threatens marine ecosystems.

title: Zoology: How Animals Are Grouped And Their Adaptations
author: BiosystemsHub Editorial Team
description: Learn how animals are classified into major vertebrate groups and discover the remarkable adaptations that help them survive in diverse environments.

title: Genetics and DNA: CRISPR and Gene Editing
author: BiosystemsHub Editorial Team
description: Learn how CRISPR edits DNA with precision, its uses in medicine, agriculture, and the environment, plus risks and common myths.

title: Genetics and DNA: Central Dogma — DNA → RNA → Protein
author: BiosystemsHub Editorial Team
description: Explore the central dogma of molecular biology: how DNA provides instructions that are transcribed into RNA and translated into proteins, the building blocks of life.

title: Genetics and DNA: How Traits Get Passed Down
author: BiosystemsHub Editorial Team
description: Understand how inherited and learned traits differ, and explore the role of dominant and recessive genes in shaping observable characteristics.

title: Genetics and DNA: What is DNA? What are Genes?
author: BiosystemsHub Editorial Team
description: A clear introduction to DNA structure, gene function, and the genetic mechanisms behind traits such as eye color and blood type.
